_hinweis: Vorgaben für neue Kletter-/Kanten-Keyframes im Stil von ShadepiRPG/tools/hero_sources/prompts.json. Referenz beim Erzeugen: das jeweilige *-keyframes.png aus ShadepiRPG. Ergebnis als tools/climb_sources/<held>-climb-keyframes.png (1536×1024) ablegen und `python tools/compile_climb.py` ausführen.
raven:
Use case: identity-preserve and illustration-story. Create a premium production-ready TRANSPARENT character keyframe sprite atlas for our 2.5D cyberpunk RPG that EXTENDS the existing hero keyframe atlas with climbing and ledge poses. Use the attached existing keyframe atlas as the exact reference for identity, costume, materials, painting style, lighting and scale; the new poses must look like they were painted in the same session. This must be beautifully painted high resolution game character art with clean silhouettes, nuanced armor plates, cloth, leather and soft material shading. NOT pixel art, not a poster, not a concept montage. ABSOLUTELY EXACT GRID: 8 columns and 4 rows, 32 separate complete full-body character poses, equally sized cells, identical character scale in every cell and the SAME scale as the reference atlas, no overlap, no character crossing a cell boundary, empty transparent gutters. Canvas landscape 3:2, exactly 1536 by 1024, cells 192 by 256. Every character fits inside the inner 80% of its own cell. NO wall, ledge, rope, floor, ground shadow, text, labels, numbers, border, scene, background, checkerboard artwork or UI. Actual transparent alpha outside the character. The surface being climbed is INVISIBLE: imagine a vertical window frame edge at the horizontal center of each cell and an invisible horizontal ledge line where each row specifies it. Hands touch these invisible lines precisely and consistently in every cell.
ROW 1 – CLIMBING UP, BACK VIEW (character faces away from the viewer, climbing a vertical edge at the cell center), a smooth 8-phase loop: 1 left hand high and right hand at shoulder height, right knee raised; 2 pulling up on left hand; 3 both hands near head height, feet together; 4 right hand reaching up, left knee starting to rise; 5 right hand high and left hand at shoulder height, left knee raised; 6 pulling up on right hand; 7 both hands near head height, feet together; 8 left hand reaching up, right knee starting to rise. Hands grip the invisible edge, arms bend naturally at the elbows, body hugs the edge, feet push against it. The top of the head stays at 18% of the cell height in all 8 cells and the highest hand never goes above 6%; only limbs move.
ROW 2 – PULL-UP ONTO A LEDGE, BACK VIEW, 8 phases left to right. The invisible ledge line sits at a FIXED height per phase so the body fits the cell: phases 1–3 ledge at 15% of cell height, phases 4–5 ledge at 45%, phases 6–8 ledge at 92% (the normal foot baseline). 1 hanging with both arms straight, both hands on the ledge line; 2 elbows bending, head rising toward the ledge; 3 chin above the ledge, elbows high; 4 both forearms flat on top of the ledge, upper body leaning over it, legs hanging below; 5 one knee lifted onto the ledge; 6 crouching on top of the ledge, both feet on the ledge line; 7 rising from the crouch; 8 standing upright on the ledge line, relaxed.
ROW 3 – SITTING ON A LEDGE, FRONT VIEW facing the viewer, buttocks exactly on the invisible ledge line at 45% of the cell height, lower legs hanging down in front, relaxed: 1 neutral, hands resting beside the hips; 2 looking left; 3 looking right; 4 leaning back on both hands; 5 swinging the left foot; 6 swinging the right foot; 7 head slightly lowered, dozing; 8 waving one hand at the viewer.
ROW 4 – CLIMBING UP IN PROFILE, 4-phase loops: cells 1–4 RIGHT profile (facing east, gripping a vertical edge at the right side of the figure), cells 5–8 LEFT profile (facing west, gripping a vertical edge at the left side), alternating hand-over-hand and knee movement like row 1.
These are 32 images of ONE character, no second character.
CHARACTER: RAVEN, adult female netrunner, light complexion, athletic slender natural proportions, straight long jet-black hair with deep cobalt blue highlights and side-swept bangs, red eyes. Her face and hair must remain recognizable and uncovered. High-end fitted matte-black armored combat bodysuit with fine glowing CYAN circuitry seams at collar, chest, waist, forearms and thighs; reinforced shoulder plates, black gloves, functional knee guards and black boots. Small restrained crimson indicator on one shoulder. A small cyan illuminated high collar. No hat, no wings, no long coat, no face mask. The suit fully covers the torso and abdomen. Elegant, capable, determined facial expression. Premium semi-realistic painted comic RPG style. Her compact impulse pistol is holstered on her thigh in ALL cells, both hands free. Premium semi-realistic painted comic RPG style, exactly matching the existing game keyframes.
